conventions: Follow strict package dependency direction: excalidraw-app -> @excalidraw/excalidraw -> @excalidraw/element -> @excalidraw/common / @excalidraw/math; packages/* must never import from excalidraw-app.
Never mutate ExcalidrawElement or AppState in place; always use newElementWith or mutateElement so version and versionNonce increment for history deltas and collaboration reconciliation.
Use app.ownerDocument and app.ownerWindow instead of global document and window wherever app is accessible.
Prefer Merge<Base, Overrides> from @excalidraw/common/utility-types over Omit<Base, ...> & Overrides.
Follow ESLint import order: external and @excalidraw/* packages first, then relative imports, then import type declarations.
Add user-facing strings only to packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json and read them via t() from packages/excalidraw/i18n.ts; never edit other locale files.
Every new AppState field must be wired in types.ts (AppState and UIAppState if used by UI), getDefaultAppState() and APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF in appState.ts, and restoreAppState() in data/restore.ts.

decisions.topic: Page-membership representation (ADR: pageId on elements vs separate per-page element arrays)
decisions.choice: Element-level optional pageId?: string on _ExcalidrawElementBase (normalized via getElementPageId(el) -> el.pageId || DEFAULT_PAGE_ID where DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = 'page-1', and omitted as an own property when equal to DEFAULT_PAGE_ID) stored in a master allElements collection in Scene with cached active-page slices for getNonDeletedElements/getElementsIncludingDeleted/frames/maps and full-collection accessors getAllElementsIncludingDeleted/getAllNonDeletedElements
rejected: Separate per-page element arrays or multiple Scene instances per page
decisions.reason: Collab reconciliation (reconcileElements, BroadcastedExcalidrawElement, Firebase sync) natively merges flat element arrays by id and version without changing wire containers; fractional indices are validated and synced per pageId group so z-order operations on one page never invalidate indices on other pages; frames are automatically scoped to the active page because Scene.frames and nonDeletedFramesLikes derive from the active-page slice; history deltas (History with per-page undo/redo stacks and StoreSnapshot preserving inactive pages' elements) isolate undo/redo per page; and .excalidraw JSON files keep a single top-level elements array for backward compatibility with single-page loaders

decisions.topic: Default page constants and deterministic PRNG / snapshot compatibility
decisions.choice: Use deterministic constants DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = 'page-1' and DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME = 'Page 1' in getDefaultAppState(), omit pageId as an own property on elements when pageId === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, omit default single-page fields in cleanAppStateForExport when untouched, and strip pages/activePageId/pageViewports in test-utils AppState snapshot serializer
rejected: Calling randomId() inside getDefaultAppState() and always setting own property pageId: 'page-1' on every created element
decisions.reason: Existing test suites call reseed(7) in beforeEach and assert exact element snapshots and AppState/SVG export snapshots; deterministic DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and omitting default-page property noise keeps all 149 existing test files and snapshot suites passing without modifying .snap files

decisions.topic: AppState page fields and APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF wiring
decisions.choice: Add pages: readonly ExcalidrawPage[], activePageId: string, and pageViewports: Record<string, PageViewport> to AppState with APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF entries pages: { browser: true, export: true, server: true }, activePageId: { browser: true, export: true, server: false }, pageViewports: { browser: true, export: true, server: false }
rejected: Setting server: true for activePageId and pageViewports
decisions.reason: The ordered page list is shared across local storage, .excalidraw file exports, and collaboration servers, whereas each collaborator keeps their own activePageId and per-page viewport state locally unless following another user

decisions.choice: History maintains per-page undo and redo stacks keyed by activePageId (with setActivePageId and deletePageHistory helpers) while Scene/Store preserves inactive pages' elements when applying active-page history deltas
rejected: Single global undo/redo stack shared across all pages
decisions.reason: Ensures Undo and Redo on the active page only revert or reapply element mutations on that page, keep the user on the active page, and never alter elements or history stacks of inactive pages

decisions.choice: Encrypt the optional pages array together with all pages' syncable elements inside Firebase StoredScene ciphertext using roomKey (with backward-compatible decryption when the decrypted JSON is either { elements, pages } or a legacy elements array) and include pages in encrypted WebSocket SCENE_INIT / SCENE_UPDATE payloads, falling back to a remaining valid page locally if a remote update deletes the local user's activePageId
rejected: Storing pages in plaintext on FirebaseStoredScene beside ciphertext and iv or adding a separate room document/custom socket event
decisions.reason: Encrypting pages inside ciphertext and SCENE_INIT/SCENE_UPDATE payloads ensures page names are end-to-end encrypted with roomKey before reaching Firebase or the relay server while remaining backward-compatible with legacy single-page documents

3. In orderByFractionalIndex, when elements contain multiple page keys, preserve relative page grouping or compare fractional indices within the same page key first, breaking cross-page ties by first-seen page order and intra-page ties by index then id.

4. In syncInvalidIndices and syncInvalidIndicesImmutable, when elements contain more than one distinct page key, group elements by getPageKey(el), synchronize invalid indices within each page slice independently, and write the updated indices back to the original array / SceneElementsMap.

3. Track private activePageId: string = DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, private allElements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[] = [], private allElementsMap = toBrandedType<SceneElementsMap>(new Map()), and private allNonDeletedElements: readonly Ordered<NonDeletedExcalidrawElement>[] = [] alongside the active-page caches (elements, elementsMap, nonDeletedElements, nonDeletedElementsMap, frames, nonDeletedFramesLikes).

4. Expose getActivePageId(): string, setActivePageId(pageId: string, options?: { triggerUpdate?: boolean }): void, getAllElementsIncludingDeleted(): readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[], getAllNonDeletedElements(): readonly Ordered<NonDeletedExcalidrawElement>[], getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted(): SceneElementsMap, and deletePageElements(pageId: string): void, where deletePageElements tombstones every element in this.allElements belonging to pageId (getElementPageId(el) === pageId && !el.isDeleted) via newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true }) so version and versionNonce bump per NFR-3 and deleted page elements stay deleted during collaboration reconciliation against a peer's stale copy rather than being removed from this.allElements, then rebuilds allElements and active-page caches and calls this.triggerUpdate().

5. In replaceAllElements(nextElements: ElementsMapOrArray, options?: { skipValidation?: true; allPages?: boolean }), determine each element's pageId via el.pageId ?? (this.allElementsMap.has(el.id) ? getElementPageId(this.allElementsMap.get(el.id)!) : options?.allPages ? DEFAULT_PAGE_ID : this.activePageId) and normalize with withElementPageId; when options?.allPages is true or normalized elements include a pageId !== this.activePageId, replace allElements with the synced multi-page list, otherwise keep inactive pages' elements from this.allElements and replace only the active page's elements; then rebuild both allElements caches and active-page caches filtered by getElementPageId(el) === this.activePageId.

units.behaviour: Render the page tab bar allowing users to switch pages, add a page, rename a page inline, reorder pages, and delete a page with confirmation.
rules: 1. Export const PageTabs = ({ appState }: { appState: UIAppState }) => JSX.Element reading app via useApp() and translations via t() from ../i18n.

2. Render a container with role="tablist" and aria-label={t("pages.tabsLabel")} containing a tab for each page in appState.pages with role="tab", aria-selected={page.id === appState.activePageId}, data-testid={`page-tab-${page.id}`}, and draggable={!appState.viewModeEnabled && editingPageId !== page.id}.

3. Clicking a tab calls app.switchPage(page.id); double-clicking a tab (or clicking its rename button with data-testid={`page-rename-${page.id}`} and aria-label={t("pages.renamePage")}) when !appState.viewModeEnabled opens an inline input (data-testid={`page-rename-input-${page.id}`}) initialized to page.name that commits via app.renamePage(page.id, draftName) on Enter or blur and cancels on Escape (stopping key event propagation so canvas shortcuts do not fire while typing).

Support reordering pages when !appState.viewModeEnabled both via HTML5 drag-and-drop (onDragStart, onDragOver, onDrop calling app.reorderPages(fromIndex, toIndex)) and via move-left / move-right buttons (data-testid={`page-move-left-${page.id}`} and data-testid={`page-move-right-${page.id}`}, disabled at boundaries).

When !appState.viewModeEnabled, render an Add Page button (data-testid="page-add-button", aria-label={t("pages.addPage")}) that calls app.addPage(), and a Delete Page button per tab (data-testid={`page-delete-${page.id}`}, aria-label={t("pages.deletePage")}, disabled when appState.pages.length <= 1) that opens ConfirmDialog (titled t("pages.deletePageConfirmTitle") with body t("pages.deletePageConfirmDescription", { pageName: page.name })) and calls app.deletePage(page.id) on confirm.

Implement addPage = (name?: string): string => creates a new page { id: randomId(), name: trimmedName || t("pages.defaultPageName", { pageNumber: this.state.pages.length + 1 }) }, saves the outgoing page's viewport { scrollX: this.state.scrollX, scrollY: this.state.scrollY, zoom: this.state.zoom } in pageViewports[currentActivePageId], switches scene and history activePageId to the new page ID, resets scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, zoom: { value: 1 as NormalizedZoomValue } and transient selection/editing state, commits CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER to this.store, and updates state.

4. Implement switchPage = (pageId: string): void => if pageId exists in this.state.pages and pageId !== this.state.activePageId, saves the outgoing page's { scrollX, scrollY, zoom } into pageViewports[this.state.activePageId], loads incomingViewport = pageViewports[pageId] ?? { scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, zoom: { value: 1 as NormalizedZoomValue } }, updates this.scene.setActivePageId(pageId) and this.history.setActivePageId(pageId), clears transient selection/hover/editing state (selectedElementIds: {}, hoveredElementIds: {}, selectedGroupIds: {}, editingTextElement: null, editingGroupId: null, editingFrame: null, activeEmbeddable: null, selectionElement: null, multiElement: null, selectedLinearElement: null), commits CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER to this.store with the new active page's elementsMap and next state, and calls this.setState.

5. Implement renamePage = (pageId: string, name: string): void => updates the target page's name in this.state.pages (trimming whitespace and falling back to t("pages.defaultPageName", { pageNumber: index + 1 }) if empty).

6. Implement reorderPages = (fromIndex: number, toIndex: number): void => moves the page at fromIndex to toIndex in this.state.pages when indices are valid and distinct without altering activePageId or elements.

7. Implement deletePage = (pageId: string): void => if this.state.pages.length <= 1 or pageId is not found, return; remove pageId from pages and pageViewports, call this.scene.deletePageElements(pageId) (which tombstones the deleted page's elements via newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true }) with a version bump for collaboration reconciliation) and this.history.deletePageHistory(pageId), and if pageId === this.state.activePageId switch to the adjacent remaining page (pages[Math.min(deletedIndex, remainingPages.length - 1)].id), restoring its viewport and committing CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER to this.store.

8. In syncActionResult, updateScene, initializeScene, resetScene, and loadFileToCanvas, keep this.scene.setActivePageId and this.history.setActivePageId synchronized with appState.activePageId, and pass { allPages: true } to this.scene.replaceAllElements when replacing the full scene; in componentDidUpdate, attach non-enumerable __allElements and __activeElements getters onto this.state so serializeAsJSON can access all pages' elements when given this.state.
